title: ProvenanceNode
description: One node in the data lineage graph. Every processing step creates one node. Together, the nodes form a DAG that traces how raw source data became final output. Spec defined in ARCHITECTURE.md section 3.3.

operation_type.description: The pipeline stage that produced this node.

agent_name.description: Name of the agent or script that performed this operation. e.g. 'pubmed_client.py', 'field_aligner.py'.

tool_name.description: Optional. Specific tool or function invoked. e.g. 'search_pubmed', 'align_fields'.

input_node_ids.description: IDs of upstream ProvenanceNodes whose outputs fed into this operation. Empty for the initial search step.

output_data_ids.description: IDs of DataRecords produced by this operation.

parameters.description: The exact parameters used. e.g. {'query': 'pancreatic cancer', 'max_results': 50}. Critical for reproducibility.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this operation ran.

duration_ms.description: Optional. How long the operation took, in milliseconds.

error_message.description: Present only if status is 'failed' or 'partial'.
